verdict.rationale: Versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions for an SDK, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers API versioning, release or semver guarantees, or a documented deprecation policy. The pack only describes agent features (tools, handoffs, tracing, sessions) and documentation-format probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
